Doctor of Philosophy in Cell & Molecular Biology
Location(s): Stratford Campus
Return to: Programs of Study
Program Requirements
Foundational Coursework: 8 s.h.
MCBN 00703 - Molecular Cell Biology and Neuroscience Foundations I Credits: 4
MCBN 00704 - Molecular Cell Biology and Neuroscience Foundations II Credits: 4
Skill Courses: 4 s.h.
MCBN 00812 - Quantitative Methods Credits: 2
MCBN 00803 - Scientific Writing Credits: 2
Focus Courses: 8-9 s.h.:
MCBN 00810 - Biomolecular Interactions Credits: 2
MCBN 00806 - Graduate Genetics Credits: 2
MBS 00602 - Antimicrobial Drugs: Mechanisms of Action and Resistance Credits: 3
MBS 00603 - Immunology Credits: 3
MBS 00612 - Principles of Pharmacology Credits: 3
MCBN 00813 - Neuroanatomy: Structure and Function of the Vertebrate Nervous System Credits: 2
MCBN 00815 - Neuropharmacology and Behavior Credits: 2
MCBN 00814 - Neurophysiology Credits: 2
MCBN 00817 - Advanced Emerging Topics in Biomedical Science Credits: 0
MCBN 00804 - Critical Readings in Molecular Cell Biology and Neuroscience Credits: 2
MCBN 00816 - Research Topics in Neurobiology Credits: 2
Additional Required Courses: minimum of 54 s.h.
MCBN 00910 - Responsible Conduct in Research Credits: 0
MCBN 00901 - Laboratory Rotation A - MCBN Credits: 2
MCBN 00902 - Laboratory Rotation B - MCBN Credits: 2
MCBN 00903 - Laboratory Rotation C - MCBN Credits: 2
MCBN 00904 - Laboratory Rotation D - MCBN Credits: 2
MCBN 00920 - Advanced Graduate Research Credits: 5 (taken twice for a total of 10 s.h.)
MCBN 00925 - Summer Research Molecular Cell Biology & Neuroscience Credits: 6 (taken at least once)
MCBN 00990 - Summer Thesis Research/PhD Credits: 6 (taken at least once)
MCBN 00999 - Thesis Research/Ph.D. Credits: 9 (taken at least 3 times for a total of 27 s.h.)
Total Required Credits for the Program: minimum of 74 s.h.
